controls.reason: Matching production behavior requires exhaustive observation of every cookie, SDK, request, experiment, replay, and provider behavior across routes, users, and time. Therefore the proposed structured-record composite does not prove the whole rule “Cookie, tracker, analytics, advertising, attribution, session-replay, and experimentation inventories match production behavior.”.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The declared inventory can match normal browsing while an experiment injects an unlisted tracker for one cohort. The proposal can Pass while “Cookie, tracker, analytics, advertising, attribution, session-replay, and experimentation inventories match production behavior.” remains false.

controls.reason: Explicit periods are recordable, but enforcement must cover every primary copy, log, cache, backup, model, export, and supplier system through time. Therefore the proposed structured-record composite does not prove the whole rule “Retention periods are explicit and enforced.”.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The policy can contain dates while an old backup or analytics warehouse never deletes expired data. The proposal can Pass while “Retention periods are explicit and enforced.” remains false.

controls.reason: No finite export test proves non-exposure for every tenant, relationship, authorization state, race, object type, and error path. Therefore the proposed structured-record composite does not prove the whole rule “Data export cannot expose other users' or tenants' information.”.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Representative tests can pass while a crafted object ID exports another tenant's attachment. The proposal can Pass while “Data export cannot expose other users' or tenants' information.” remains false.

controls.reason: Owner IDs are structured, but accountability and completeness across every product and processing purpose require organizational authority and a complete purpose inventory. controls.counterexample_analysis: Every listed purpose can name a steward while a shadow analytics purpose is omitted or the named owner lacks authority. The proposal can Pass while “Assign accountable privacy owners and data stewards for every product and processing purpose.” remains false.

controls.reason: A privacy inventory cannot prove complete personal-data scope, real purposes, lawful basis, authorization, recipients, locations, and deletion obligations. The proposal can Pass while “Maintain an inventory of personal data, sources, purposes, lawful basis or authorization, recipients, locations, retention, and deletion.” remains false.

controls.reason: The full personal-data flow graph spans clients, services, logs, suppliers, backups, models, support, and exports, including undeclared and transient paths. Therefore the proposed structured-record composite does not prove the whole rule “Map personal-data flows across clients, services, logs, analytics, support, suppliers, backups, models, and exports.”.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Known flows can reconcile while support exports data to an unregistered tool or a model retains training examples. The proposal can Pass while “Map personal-data flows across clients, services, logs, analytics, support, suppliers, backups, models, and exports.” remains false.

controls.reason: Consistency with deployed behavior requires complete runtime observation and semantic interpretation of what notices and privacy records promise. Therefore the proposed structured-record composite does not prove the whole rule “Keep privacy records and notices consistent with deployed behavior.”.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Text and declared events can match while an undocumented retry path sends data to a different recipient. The proposal can Pass while “Keep privacy records and notices consistent with deployed behavior.” remains false.

controls.reason: Monitoring cannot prove complete coverage of dynamic flows and trackers, and whether a change is authorized depends on current accountable approval. Therefore the proposed structured-record composite does not prove the whole rule “Monitor data flows and trackers for unauthorized change.”.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The scanner can watch known tags while a server-side SDK changes destination without detection. The proposal can Pass while “Monitor data flows and trackers for unauthorized change.” remains false.

controls.reason: Counts and times are computable, but rights completeness, deletion effectiveness, minimization, unexpected collection, and risk reduction require complete data and outcome oracles. controls.counterexample_analysis: A dashboard can improve because undeleted backups and unknown collections are absent from its denominator. controls.reason: Training timestamps are exact, but role appropriateness, actual competence, and complete personal-data access coverage require accountable human judgment. controls.counterexample_analysis: A user can complete irrelevant training before access while lacking knowledge needed for the role. The proposal can Pass while “Train role-appropriate personnel before granting personal-data access.” remains false.

controls.reason: A lifecycle document does not prove that privacy behavior is complete, lawful, and effective across migration, backups, deprecation, and retirement. controls.counterexample_analysis: The plan can cover the main store while retired backups silently restore old consent and deleted profiles. The proposal can Pass while “Define privacy behavior through deprecation, migration, backup, and retirement.” remains false.

controls.reason: Notice fields do not prove complete data collection, purposes, subjects, uses, recipients, retention, protections, and controls or their legal accuracy. Therefore the proposed structured-record composite does not prove the whole rule “Describe what data is collected, why, from whom, how used, shared, retained, protected, and controlled.”.
controls.counterexample_analysis: A notice can contain every heading while omitting an SDK recipient or describing an unlawful use inaccurately. The proposal can Pass while “Describe what data is collected, why, from whom, how used, shared, retained, protected, and controlled.” remains false.

controls.reason: Whether processing is genuinely required or optional depends on product necessity, contractual context, and legal basis, not an enum label. controls.counterexample_analysis: Advertising can be labeled required and pass the schema even though the service works without it. The proposal can Pass while “Distinguish required processing from optional analytics, personalization, advertising, sharing, or communication.” remains false.

controls.reason: Nonessential status, valid permission, and where permission is legally required need specialist authority, while prevention spans all processing paths. controls.counterexample_analysis: The visible page can block analytics before consent while a server-side tracker starts earlier or consent is legally invalid. The proposal can Pass while “Prevent nonessential processing before valid permission where required.” remains false.

controls.reason: Notice version, choice, time, and context are exact, but proof sufficiency, valid purpose, and whether evidence collection is excessive are contextual and legal judgments. controls.counterexample_analysis: A consent row can contain all fields while storing a full device fingerprint as excessive proof. The proposal can Pass while “Record notice version, purpose, choice, time, context, and proof without collecting excessive evidence.” remains false.

controls.reason: A documented consent state machine cannot prove that no interface, imported preference, timeout, or background job treats silence as agreement. Therefore the proposed structured-record composite does not prove the whole rule “Avoid using inactivity as agreement.”.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The main form can require a click while a banner timeout or prechecked mobile path records consent without action. The proposal can Pass while “Avoid using inactivity as agreement.” remains false.

controls.reason: “Explicitly” handling conflicts needs a complete device, account, organization, and channel precedence policy plus product- and law-specific semantics. controls.counterexample_analysis: A precedence table can exist while an enterprise override silently defeats a user's legally controlling choice. The proposal can Pass while “Handle conflicting preferences across devices, accounts, organizations, and channels explicitly.” remains false.

controls.reason: Monitoring records are partial evidence; complete choice enforcement, contradiction detection, and adequate investigation require all flows and accountable analysis. controls.counterexample_analysis: Known pipelines can show no contradiction while a supplier continues processing after opt-out. The proposal can Pass while “Monitor preference enforcement and investigate processing that contradicts user choice.” remains false.

controls.reason: Obsolescence, retention, and audit need depend on legal duties and evidentiary purpose rather than record age alone. Therefore the proposed structured-record composite does not prove the whole rule “Retire obsolete consent records according to retention and audit needs.”.

controls.reason: Documentation does not prove restoration safety, and tests cannot cover every backup, snapshot, replica, tombstone, consumer, and restore sequence. controls.reason: Request times and fields are exact, but complete intake, deadlines, exceptions, decisions, and evidence depend on jurisdiction, subject scope, and legal authority. controls.counterexample_analysis: All registered requests can pass while an email request is omitted or an exception is legally invalid. The proposal can Pass while “Track requests, deadlines, exceptions, decisions, and completion evidence.” remains false.

controls.reason: Representative accounts and complex examples are not an exhaustive oracle for every right, identity link, data relationship, supplier, exception, and failure. controls.counterexample_analysis: Tests can pass for common accounts while a merged identity leaves one profile undeleted. The proposal can Pass while “Test rights workflows end to end using representative accounts and complex data relationships.” remains false.

controls.reason: Timings and counts are computable only after complete request and downstream populations exist; completeness and propagation truth are not bounded. controls.counterexample_analysis: Metrics can look good because failures in an unlisted subprocessor never enter the dataset. The proposal can Pass while “Measure timeliness, completeness, error, rework, and downstream propagation.” remains false.

controls.reason: The labels have technical definitions, but accurate classification depends on reidentification risk, context, external data, purpose, and applicable law.
